comments.text: hear me out: put all the stuff into a shipping container and put it on a train and if thats not possible then use road trains, in australia you are allowed up to 4 trailers in some states and most states allow 3 trailers, this is allowed on dirt and poorly constructed roads so the US should have 0 problem allowing them on interstates and other highways, all that needs to be done is make intersections wider so trucks have room to turn but american roads are already oversized so this isnt an issue
